# PortNexus

PortNexus is a trade document screening application. It compares selected fields extracted from letters of credit, invoices, and bills of lading, and marks missing or differing values for qualified human review.

## Current scope

- Parses selected SWIFT MT700 fields.
- Extracts candidate document fields with the configured Gemini model. Tesseract OCR is available for supported images. Scanned PDF pages need a configured renderer for local OCR.
- Runs a limited set of deterministic field comparisons. It does not decide bank acceptance or determine legal compliance.
- Returns keyword-based HS code candidates from a small sample dataset. Bundled duty rates are unverified examples and must not be used for customs declarations.
- Provides a static illustrative trade graph and a small local keyword corpus. Verify results against current official sources.
- Exposes a stateless MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint at `/api/mcp`. Protected operations require organization authentication.
- Produces a QR-linked HMAC-SHA-256 certificate only when complete evidence is durably persisted and signing is configured. It does not certify customs clearance or guarantee bank acceptance.

## Public endpoints

- Application: https://portnexus.equisaas-bd.com/
- API health: https://portnexus.equisaas-bd.com/api/health
- MCP: https://portnexus.equisaas-bd.com/api/mcp
- Certificate verification: https://portnexus.equisaas-bd.com/verify?id=:certId
- Source: https://github.com/kholipha-ahmmad-al-amin/PortNexus
